rows.jyutping: deoi3 A ge3 tai2 m4 hei2
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for contempt directed at a person or group.

example.english: I still remember their scorn for us.
example.traditional: 佢哋對我哋嘅睇唔起，我到而家都仲記得。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 tai2 m4 hei2 ngo5 dou3 ji4 gaa1 dou1 zung6 gei3 dak1

rows.note: Use this when the scorn takes the form of an insulting or degrading slight.

example.english: Calling someone useless in public is pure scorn.
example.traditional: 當眾話人廢柴，根本就係一種侮辱。
example.jyutping: dong1 zung3 waa6 jan4 fai3 caai4 gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 jat1 zung2 mou5 juk6
